description: A U-tube in a closed tank: a baffle (solid, direct forcing) from the lid down to 0.15 m divides the air above the water into the left chamber and the closed right chamber; the surface starts tilted, higher on the right. The single-phase level set with the closed air pockets (F 41 2): the right chamber is a pocket and holds its water column with the pressure of its expansion (about -700 Pa); with F 41 1 the levels equalise (validation 89).
covers: cfd_pocket: labelling, the volume from the flux of the water, the adiabatic pressure
pic_gfm_grad with the pressure of the pocket at the surface, presscorr
